I will critically evaluate the claim frequency prediction model, assessing its performance and providing feedback on the modelling process.

* **ModellingAgent:**
  • Evaluate model choice and assumptions
  • Assess model performance metrics (e.g., MAE, MAPE, R-squared)
  • Analyze model interpretability and explainability
  • Check for overfitting and underfitting
  • Compare model performance with baseline models or benchmarks
